entries.title: II Timothy 2:1
segments: ¶You therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:2
segments: And the things that you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit these to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:3
segments: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:4
segments: No one engaged in warfare entangles himself with the affairs of [this] life, that he may please him who enlisted him as a soldier.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:5
segments: And also if anyone competes in athletics, he is not crowned unless he competes according to the rules.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:6
segments: The hard-working farmer must be first to partake of the crops.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:7
segments: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:8
segments: ¶Remember that Jesus Christ, of the seed of David, was raised from the dead according to my gospel,

entries.title: II Timothy 2:9
segments: for which I suffer trouble as an evildoer, [even] to the point of chains; but the word of God is not chained.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:10
segments: Therefore I endure all things for the sake of the elect, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:11
segments: [This is] a faithful saying: For if we died with [Him], We shall also live with [Him].

entries.title: II Timothy 2:12
segments: If we endure, We shall also reign with [Him]. If we deny [Him], He also will deny us.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:13
segments: If we are faithless, He remains faithful; He cannot deny Himself.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:14
segments: ¶Remind [them] of these things, charging [them] before the Lord not to strive about words to no profit, to the ruin of the hearers.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:15
segments: Be diligent to present yourself approved to God, a worker who does not need to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:16
segments: But shun profane [and] idle babblings, for they will increase to more ungodliness.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:17
segments: And their message will spread like cancer. Hymenaeus and Philetus are of this sort,

entries.title: II Timothy 2:18
segments: who have strayed concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past; and they overthrow the faith of some.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:19
segments: ¶Nevertheless the solid foundation of God stands, having this seal: "The Lord knows those who are His," and, "Let everyone who names the name of Christ depart from iniquity."

entries.title: II Timothy 2:20
segments: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay, some for honor and some for dishonor.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:21
segments: Therefore if anyone cleanses himself from the latter, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified and useful for the Master, prepared for every good work.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:22
segments: ¶Flee also youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:23
segments: But avoid foolish and ignorant disputes, knowing that they generate strife.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:24
segments: And a servant of the Lord must not quarrel but be gentle to all, able to teach, patient,

entries.title: II Timothy 2:25
segments: in humility correcting those who are in opposition, if God perhaps will grant them repentance, so that they may know the truth,

entries.title: II Timothy 2:26
segments: and [that] they may come to their senses [and escape] the snare of the devil, having been taken captive by him to [do] his will.
